newsitem.title: USA: Giga Information says it withdraws IPO.
newsitem.headline: Giga Information says it withdraws IPO.

text.p: Giga Information Group Inc said on Monday that it is withdrawing its public offering due to market conditions.

On November 8, Lehman Brothers, the underwriters, had previously said that the initial public offering was not to be completed and the company would have to refile a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The company provides information, analysis and advice relating to the computing, telecommunications and related industries to support information technology decisions of its customers.
